definitions.gloss: one's place on a register; family register; enrollment
definitions.explanation: One's official registration as a member of a household, organization, or school: above all one's entry in the family register ({戸籍|こせき}), and also one's enrollment or membership on a roll.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧、{籍|せき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れます→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: We're registering our marriage next month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{籍|せき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{置|お}いた→置く：01092_oku⟧まま⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: I'm working while still enrolled at the university.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{挙|あ}げ→挙げる：27889_ageru⟧ず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{籍|せき}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧ことにした。
examples.english: The two of them decided not to have a wedding and just register their marriage.

notes:
On its own, {籍|せき} most often means the family register, and {籍|せき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧ is the everyday way to say a couple has legally married.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {籍|せき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to register a marriage, to marry legally
- {籍|せき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{置|お}く→置く：01092_oku⟧: to be enrolled in, to be on the books of (a school, a company)
- {籍|せき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}く→抜く：02384_nuku⟧: to remove one's name from a register (on divorce, or on leaving a household)

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{戸籍|こせき}→戸籍：12695_koseki⟧: family register
- ⟦{国籍|こくせき}→国籍：02755_kokuseki⟧: nationality
- ⟦{入籍|にゅうせき}→入籍：19149_nyuuseki⟧: entry into a register; registering a marriage
- ⟦{在籍|ざいせき}→在籍：21436_zaiseki⟧: being enrolled or on the staff
